# Digests

Read `core.md` for every task, then the digests for the artifacts. A rule's Why and Source are not in a digest: read the full rule when a rule is unclear or you need its evidence (`grep -rn -A10 '^## <ID> ' common/languages common/writing common/principles`).

| Artifact | Digests |
| --- | --- |
| Go, Pulumi | `languages-go.md`, `languages-pulumi.md` |
| Python | `languages-python.md` |
| Shell | `languages-shell.md` |
| Kubernetes and Helm YAML | `languages-yaml.md`, `languages-yaml-kubernetes.md` |
| Workflows | `languages-github-actions.md`, `languages-yaml.md` |
| Renovate | `languages-renovate.md` |
| mise | `languages-mise.md` |
| Nix | `languages-nix.md` |
| Typst | `languages-typst.md` |
| Dockerfile, DNS, Home Assistant YAML | `languages-config-other.md`, `languages-yaml.md` |
| Makefile | `languages-makefile.md` |
| README | `writing-repo-readme.md`, `writing-prose.md` |
| Runbook, docs | `writing-runbook.md`, `writing-prose.md` |
| Commit | `writing-commit.md` |
| PR, issue | `writing-pr-issue.md` |
| Email | `writing-email.md` |
| Agent files, AGENTS.md, CHANGELOG, llms.txt | `writing-prose.md` |
| Test code (add the language digest) | `principles-tests.md` |
| New repo, CI, tooling setup (with the new-repository file checklist) | `repo-setup.md` |

Add a principles digest only when the task needs it: `principles-errors-logging.md`, `principles-tests.md`, `principles-naming.md`, `principles-structure.md`, `principles-comments.md`, `principles-tooling.md`, `principles-concision.md`, `principles-tone.md`, `principles-change-hygiene.md`. `core.md` holds their `must` rules, except the repo-setup ones.

Legend:

- `[tool:x]`: a configured tool in the owner's repos enforces the rule.
- A digest shows strength only. No rule is `open`: every decision is made.
- A rule for new files or scripts applies to files created or substantially rewritten; existing files stay unless touched.
- Pulumi program: a repo that deploys stacks (github-infrastructure, vault, home-cluster infrastructure). Pulumi library: a reusable Go package of resources (shared-library).
- IaC and config repo: deploys or configures infrastructure. Library and client repo: a published package (shared-library, onyx-client).
